title: Ada and the Room
author: Zephyrine Underhill
blurb: Elodie Amberdale, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
